symptoms: POST /checkout returns 502 for about 35% of requests after a traffic spike.
root_cause: The database connection pool was exhausted because the checkout API opened long-lived connections during a retry storm.
fix: Reduced retry fan-out, capped connection lifetime, and increased the pool from 40 to 80.
lesson: When checkout traffic spikes, check DB pool saturation before changing application logic.

symptoms: Intermittent 502s on checkout; database connections climb to the configured maximum.
root_cause: A retry loop in the payment client amplified failed requests and consumed the DB connection pool.
fix: Added exponential backoff, limited retries to two attempts, and raised the pool limit.
lesson: A retry storm can look like a database failure even when the database itself is healthy.

symptoms: Users are repeatedly logged out after a deployment; token refresh requests return 401.
root_cause: The new token refresh code used a different signing-key version than the session middleware.
fix: Aligned key-version configuration and added an integration test covering refresh across deployments.
lesson: Authentication changes must be checked together with session middleware and key-version configuration.

symptoms: Product search latency jumps from 180ms to more than 2 seconds after a catalog import.
root_cause: The import created a large number of unindexed rows used by the search query.
fix: Added the missing composite index and moved the import to a staged process.
lesson: After bulk catalog changes, inspect query plans and indexes before increasing compute.

symptoms: Email notifications are delayed by 20–30 minutes while the worker queue keeps growing.
root_cause: A provider timeout caused each job to be retried synchronously, reducing worker throughput.
fix: Moved retries to delayed jobs, added a timeout budget, and increased worker concurrency.
lesson: Synchronous retries can turn a provider timeout into a queue backlog.
